# Work schema25 cutover

Scope: appservice `main` steady state. The frozen `rebuild/recovery`
composition is separate. This is a prepared procedure; execution requires live
receipts. Existing identity revision 11 and all commissioned scopes remain.

Service `vuoro-service-v0.1.95` consumes Sprintctl0.19.0, which applies schemas
23, 24 and 25 in one owner migration. Live today: schema22, service0.1.93
(Sprintctl0.18.0), Job `vuoro-work-migrate-v22` Complete.

Release `vuoro-service-v0.1.95`, source
`a8313e40755c2df972b9a13221806da94e9813cb` (vuoro PR #222), consumes released
Sprintctl0.19.0 (source `ad66ddd030dac7134e212df328f2cb5b82639bdc`). Published
wheel SHA256:
`6d819cf607ccbeb65d5c6d56705388b2b005fa82bdaa30d7bd975573026b8f26`.
Immutable OCI index:
`sha256:b3e4097fb9e30e956d136cbe9046ac163a0549c508f690c149b885989a63f2ad`;
linux/amd64 manifest:
`sha256:a3eede553cb470d1305707a3d744a8dddf7745029fdeed9a8fa9ae5851d235fb`.
The same index digest is pinned in `vuoro-work-migrate-v25.yaml` and
`vuoro-shared/app/deployment.yaml`. The actual image passed the replay below.

**Do not merge outside the runbook window: merging starts the migration once
`vuoro-shared-db` reconciles.**

## What the migration adds

| Schema | Objects (owner `vuoro_work_migration`) | Runtime grant |
|---|---|---|
| 23 | `work_run_invocation_binding`, `work_run_invocation_attempt`, index `idx_work_run_invocation_attempt_owner`; functions `sprintctl_run_invocation_{immutable_guard,binding_guard,attempt_guard,has_attempt}`; 7 triggers (insert guards, immutable, no-truncate, deferred `binding_has_attempt`) | SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE; no DELETE/TRUNCATE. UPDATE is for `FOR UPDATE`/`FOR KEY SHARE` row locks only; triggers refuse every UPDATE |
| 24 | index `idx_evidence_item_effect_verification_subject` on `evidence_item` | none |
| 25 | `agent_instance`, `agent_declaration_revision`, `agent_observation`, `agent_inbox_counter`, `agent_message`, `agent_message_receipt`; 9 indexes; identity sequences for `observation_id` and `receipt_seq`; functions `sprintctl_agent_append_only`, `sprintctl_agent_instance_guard`; 10 triggers | instance, message, counter: SELECT/INSERT/UPDATE (instance retire UPDATE, counter allocation UPDATE, `FOR UPDATE/SHARE/NO KEY UPDATE` locks); declaration, observation, receipt: SELECT/INSERT. No DELETE/TRUNCATE anywhere |

Schema23 also row-locks `run` (`FOR KEY SHARE`, in Sprintctl and in the
invoker-rights binding guard), so the runtime must keep UPDATE on `run`. The
Job preflight refuses before DDL if it is missing. appservice PR #1856 as
authored revokes it; it must drop `run` from its revoke list before either
change merges (evidence_item and session_note are unaffected).

The migration refuses foreign pre-existing schema23/25 objects and commits with
the owner's existing migration lock. Startup never migrates. Service0.1.95
refuses schema22; service0.1.93 refuses schema25 (minimum 25).

## Writer fence and recovery point

Before merging, capture pre-state read-only (`KUBECONFIG=clusters/.kube/config`):

```sh
flux get ks vuoro-shared vuoro-shared-db
kubectl -n vuoro-shared get deploy vuoro-shared -o jsonpath='{.metadata.annotations}{"\n"}{.spec.template.spec.containers[0].image}{"\n"}'
kubectl -n vuoro-shared get jobs,cronjobs,pods -o wide
```

Record schema22, image, catalog, identity revision, database/cluster identities
and all writer sources (deployments, jobs, cronjobs, external clients, database
sessions). Suspending Flux alone does not suspend a CronJob or stop an external
process. A zero-pod or zero-session observation verifies the fence at that
instant; it does not prevent reconnection by itself.

```sh
flux suspend kustomization vuoro-shared
flux suspend kustomization vuoro-shared-db
kubectl -n vuoro-shared scale deploy/vuoro-shared --replicas=0
kubectl -n vuoro-shared wait --for=delete pod -l app.kubernetes.io/name=vuoro-shared --timeout=180s
kubectl -n vuoro-shared create job --from=cronjob/cnpg-pgdump-age cnpg-pgdump-age-v25-pre
kubectl -n vuoro-shared wait --for=condition=complete job/cnpg-pgdump-age-v25-pre --timeout=900s
```

`cnpg-pgdump-age` also runs hourly at :53 and is a database client the initial
migration refuses; resume the database away from that minute, or
`kubectl -n vuoro-shared patch cronjob cnpg-pgdump-age -p '{"spec":{"suspend":true}}'`
for the window and unsuspend after step 5.
Stop every other writer source and keep it stopped through migration and grant
qualification. Keep the dump object identity and completion evidence privately.
Capture preserved work/audit row digests and the complete schema ledger after
fencing. Do not print decrypted values, credentials or database URLs.

## Execution

1. Validate authored manifests, exact image provenance and the replay below
   against the published image. Record the checkpoint in served work before the
   served process is stopped.
2. Establish the fence and recovery point. Merge the exact reviewed desired
   state, `flux reconcile source git cluster`, reconfirm both suspensions and
   zero old writers. Resume only the database:
   `flux resume kustomization vuoro-shared-db`.
3. Observe `kubectl -n vuoro-shared wait --for=condition=complete
   job/vuoro-work-migrate-v25 --timeout=600s`. It requires matching effective
   migration/runtime database and schema with distinct roles and runtime UPDATE
   on `run`. Initial22 migration refuses old pods, runtime sessions and every
   other database backend; completed25 re-runs perform no DDL. It runs once
   (`backoffLimit:0`, `restartPolicy:Never`). On failure inspect the actual
   schema (`kubectl -n vuoro-shared logs job/vuoro-work-migrate-v25`) and job
   outcome before preparing any explicit retry Job.
4. Verify from the Job log: `to_version: 25`, runtime `remote-schema check`
   `compatible: true` with run-invocation and agent-inbox fingerprints
   available, the grant line, and the guard line (exact trigger/function/event
   bindings for schema22 attempts, schema23 invocations and schema25 agent
   tables; schema24 index; no runtime CREATE/ALTER; nonprivileged runtime role
   without migration/owner membership). Confirm complete unchanged legacy
   work/audit rows against the fenced digests.
5. Resume the runtime only after qualification:
   `flux resume kustomization vuoro-shared`. Verify the Ready pod image equals
   the filled digest, installed Sprintctl0.19.0 closure, startup handshake
   work25/audit compatible, catalog count and revision
   (catalog102 operations: 97 work, 5 audit; revision
   `fd49d79de14a0ec630dde511928cc76e3aceb2e159266f883dcbe6ab14853d2b`),
   identity revision11 and ordinary served continuity. Verify both Flux
   Kustomizations and post-merge CI, then release any separately stopped
   writers and record the checkpoint.

## Failure and rollback (forward only)

Before the migration commits, schema22 resumes with service0.1.93 after
diagnosis: revert the merge, resume `vuoro-shared-db`, then `vuoro-shared`.
Once25 commits, retain25 and use a reviewed compatible forward image. A
stopped-service restore from the verified encrypted dump is a separate
coordinated operation that accounts for later writes. Never rewrite the version
ledger, drop guards or tables, or deploy service0.1.93 as ordinary rollback.

## Replay qualification

`docs/scripts/verify-vuoro-work-schema25-cutover.sh` owns a disposable loopback
PostgreSQL16 and a synthetic TLS Kubernetes API. The old owner is the published
0.1.93 image; the new owner is the actual Job image (`CUTOVER_NEW_VENV`, a venv
with Sprintctl0.19.0 and psycopg, substitutes a local build for pre-release checks). It exercises
scaled-up and Running/Pending pod refusal, runtime and another-role session
refusal, missing `run` UPDATE refusal, initial migration and catalog-stable
completed25 replay, exact legacy intent and row preservation, a correlated run
invocation receipt and a full agent register/observe/send/receipt/retire cycle
as the runtime role with the Job grants, append-only/delete refusals, and that
revoking UPDATE on `run` or `agent_message` breaks the 0.19.0 lock paths.

```sh
CUTOVER_PG_BINDIR=/nix/store/<postgresql-16>/bin CUTOVER_TEST_PYTHON=<python with psycopg+PyYAML> \
  docs/scripts/verify-vuoro-work-schema25-cutover.sh
```

This qualifies the authored script, not live Flux/RBAC/egress. The spent v22
Job remains historical source in `docs/migrations/archive/vuoro-shared-db/`.
